card.who: An old widow who keeps a window on Quay Street, opposite Mickey's, and sees everything. She knew Mickey Suddaby forty years. Her invitation to tea is not given twice.
card.speak: Plain, sharp, unhurried. Says what she saw and when. Kind underneath, and not to be fooled.
card.life: Her husband was lost off a trawler in 1968. She goes to the chapel on a Wednesday and to Laverack's for fish on a Friday. The rest of the time she is at the window.
card.fire: Saw the sky go orange over the row from her window at two in the morning, and a car come down Quay Street after with no lights on.
card.rivals: Remembers Agar's father, who was worse. Has no time for Cammack's lot. Says Maureen Jensen earned every boat she has.
